name: Siroto
description: The Siroto was a starship utilized by the Orphans, a group led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha, during the time of the Galactic Empire. The members of the Orphans—the droid Ladybright, Sear, and Imara Vex—operated under Cha aboard the vessel. When the Orphans were recruited into the plans of Lady Qi'ra, leader of the resurgent Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, they utilized the Siroto in a number of anonymous attacks against other syndicates in order to help Qi'ra lead them into war with one another.
